name: Prime Directive
mandate: Harm prevention of universal scope. Owns the safety enforcement plane, transfer matrix, path-separation invariant, scheduling priority ordering and the permanently-excluded set.

name: Ingestion & Sensory Intake
mandate: Conversion of external content in any modality into candidate records. The sole location of any trained component.

name: Knowledge Substrate
mandate: Custody of records and lineage. The only domain with write authority over the store.

name: Ontology & Conceptual Structure
mandate: What concepts exist and how they relate. Readable by all, writable only by itself.

name: Retrieval & Response
mandate: Answering a bounded query. The latency-critical path.

name: Inference, Prediction & Calibration
mandate: What the records imply and how well it was derived. Deduction may write; induction may not.

name: World Model & Perception
mandate: How the world behaves, held distinctly from what sources asserted. Includes equipment control.

name: Grounded Expression
mandate: Rendering under the vocabulary constraint. No retrieval authority, no write path.

name: Access, Rights & Retention
mandate: What a requester may reach, retention, key custody. Executes before retrieval.

name: Interaction Surfaces
mandate: Presentation. No authority over content, retrieval or rights.

name: Authoring, Editions & Publication
mandate: Admission and shaping of authored work; emission in distributable form.

name: Platform Governance & Evolution
mandate: Change under human authority. Structurally forbidden from changing D0.

name: External Integration & Analysis
mandate: Reach beyond the boundary. Analytical output quarantined.

name: Commerce & Entitlement Tokens
mandate: Commercial presentation and entitlement. Lowest scheduling priority.

name: Learning & Assessment
mandate: Assessment from grounding records, mastery measurement, credential issuance.
